messages:
Diego (support): FYI customer 'BrightApps' reporting intermittent 502s and huge tail latency on their Dedicated cluster. They gave a few request IDs: req_0a1b2c3d, req_4e5f6g7h, req_9z8y7x6w. Errors started ~2026-11-02 15:12 UTC.
Kyler (SRE): Thanks. Can you paste a raw curl we can use to repro? Also which cluster/tenant?
Diego (support): Tenant: brightapps-prod, cluster: ded-nyc-03. Customer sent a curl but with prod token — redacted here. Here's the repro they ran (redacted token):
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://ded-nyc-03.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Diego (support): They said 502s about 1-2x / min during a 20m window, tail latency up to 9s.
Kyler (SRE): Ok. First step: collect request traces from the router and the replica handling those req ids. Run on controller:
```bash
# find pod that proxied the request ids
kubectl -n redwood get pods -l app=router -o wide
# then grep logs for the ids
kubectl -n redwood logs router-xxxxx | egrep "req_0a1b2c3d|req_4e5f6g7h|req_9z8y7x6w" --context 3
```
Kyler (SRE): Also grab the replica pod logs that served the model: pods look like modelname-abcde-xxxxx. We need startup/oom/gpu errors.
Anita M: I'll take node-level stuff. Can someone run `kubectl describe pod <replica-pod>` and share the events? I want node name to ssh.
Diego (support): Pasting the customer's snippet of kubectl get pods output they sent: 
```
NAME                                   READY STATUS   RESTARTS AGE
bright-model-5d8f7c9c7c-qpz4x        1/1 Running  0       3d
router-6f5b4c9d6f-ptj9k             2/2 Running  1       10d
```
Sam K: For GPU metrics collect DCGM stats and nvidia-smi while reproducing: 
```bash
# on node
ssh core@<node>
sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv -l 1 > /tmp/nvidia-smi.log &
sudo /opt/dcgm/dcgm-exporter --once > /tmp/dcgm.json || true
```
Sam K: Also get dmesg and journal around the time window: `sudo journalctl -k -u kubelet --since "2026-11-02 15:00" --until "2026-11-02 15:40" > /tmp/kubelet.log` and `sudo dmesg -T > /tmp/dmesg.log`.
Diego (support): Customer uploaded a short curl trace and the router logs to their support ticket. I'll download and re-run the curl from our staging network to confirm.
infra-bot: Debug bundle CLI is available: `redwood-debug collect --tenant brightapps-prod --since 2026-11-02T15:00Z --until 2026-11-02T15:30Z --request-ids req_0a1b2c3d,req_4e5f6g7h,req_9z8y7x6w --output /tmp/bright-bundle.tgz`
debug-bot: Note: bundle includes kube manifests, pod logs, node metrics, nvidia-smi snapshots. Upload to s3://redwood-debug/brightapps/ if size > 50MB.
Kyler (SRE): If you see kernel crash messages (gpu reset, Xid) in dmesg, paste the lines. Those often explain transient 502s when the GPU driver resets. Example to grep: `dmesg | egrep "NVRM|Xid|GPU fault|GPU reset"`.
Anita M: If we need deeper GPU telemetry, run DCGM health check on the node: `sudo /opt/dcgm/dcgmhealth` and attach result.
Diego (support): I'm running the debug collect now against ded-nyc-03; will upload link when done.
Sam K: Also check model-side logs for KV cache thrash: grep for "kv-cache" and "evict" in model container logs. That can explain long init pauses.
Diego (support): Uploaded bundle to s3://redwood-debug/brightapps/1900123456-bright-bundle.tgz (link shared in ticket). Ticket ID: 98765.
Kyler (SRE): Nice. I pulled the bundle locally and saw router timeout entries around 2026-11-02T15:12:09Z pointing to 502s returned after replica timed out waiting for tokens from the runtime.
Kyler (SRE): Next: can we repro with a looped curl and attach the complete `--trace-ascii` tcpdump from the node? Something like: `curl --trace-ascii /tmp/trace.log ...` while running the scenario.
Diego (support): Customer agreed to run a 10m repro window tonight 02:00 UTC and to share the raw curl + trace. I'll coordinate and update here. :thumbsup:
Anita M: I'll standby to grab dmesg + nvidia-smi when they repro. If we find Xid/gpu reset we'll escalate to drivers.
Sam K: Also recommend temporarily switching routing policy to route to spare capacity (ded-nyc-04) to reduce impact while we debug.
Diego (support): Ticket 98765 updated: mitigation suggested, repro scheduled, bundle uploaded. Assigning to Kyler for deep analysis.
Kyler (SRE): Thanks — will post findings after the repro run.
Diego (support): Closing the loop with the customer and leaving the channel open for updates.
